entries.title: terpd 6.3.1 (replaces 6.3.0 at the v6.3 halt)
entries.summary: morocco-1 halted at 23893261 for plan v6.3. The published 6.3.0 ELF exits while opening the store on nodes that ran v6.1 (orphan b3-* trees). 6.3.1 is the same upgrade with that open fixed; no new proposal. Place it in cosmovisor/upgrades/v6.3/bin/terpd, keep 6.4.0 in upgrades/v6.4, and keep DAEMON_ALLOW_DOWNLOAD_BINARIES=false. v6.4 stays armed at 23893263.

entries.title: terpd 6.2.1
entries.summary: Same-home binary replacement for nodes already on 6.2.0. Not a governance software-upgrade plan; Cosmovisor will not download it. Every signing node switches in the same step so the set stays consistent when a contract transaction runs.
